mapper.sql: select id, inbound_no, rela_ent_nm, busi_type, rela_customs_form_type, rela_customs_form_num, in_out_time, doc_status, customs_status, execute_type, last_uuid, remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time from br_inbound
mapper.insert: insert into br_inbound (inbound_no, rela_ent_nm, busi_type, rela_customs_form_type, rela_customs_form_num, in_out_time, doc_status, customs_status, execute_type, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{inboundNo}, #{relaEntNm}, #{busiType}, #{relaCustomsFormType}, #{relaCustomsFormNum}, #{inOutTime}, '01', '00', '1', #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update br_inbound set update_time = sysdate(), last_uuid = #{uuid}, doc_status = #{docStatus}, customs_status = #{customsStatus}, execute_type = #{executeType} where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: update br_inbound set del_flag = '2' where id in #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into br_inbound_item (inbound_id, material_id, storage_cnt, price, currency, unit1_num, unit2_num, brand_type, trade_mode_cd, arriving_country_code, end_country_code, specifications_models, goods_source_type, goods_source_no, busi_desc, busi_form_num) values (#{inboundId}, #{materialId}, #{storageCnt}, #{price}, #{currency}, #{unit1Num}, #{unit2Num}, #{brandType}, #{tradeModeCd}, #{arrivingCountryCode}, #{endCountryCode}, #{specificationsModels}, #{goodsSourceType}, #{goodsSourceNo}, #{busiDesc}, #{busiFormNum})
